<parameter=code>
# Player at (37, 39) after moving LEFT. Let me check current state and try clicking purple blocks near player

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
b = player['boundary']
player_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
player_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
print(f"Player at ({player_r},{player_c})")

# Find purple blocks near player column
purs = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p' and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) < 60]
for n in purs:
    b = n['boundary']
    minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
    minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
    maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
    maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
    dist = abs(minc - player_c)
    print(f"  Purple at ({minr},{minc})-({maxr},{maxc}), dist={dist}")

# Player at col 39, purple at col 38 is closest
# Try clicking the purple block at (13, 38)
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 15, 'col': 39}])
print(f"\nClick purple (15,39): game_over={result.get('game_over')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green remaining: {len(greens)}")
if result.get('gameplay_changed'):
    player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    b = player['boundary']
    player_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    player_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    print(f"Player now at ({player_r},{player_c})")
</parameter>
</function>
